paragraphs.text: Time Anchor for DSH: pin the agent as-of clock and add a dated evidence window
# dsh-time-pin · 时间锚定 · Time Anchor
English | 中文

`npm` dsh-time-pin ·
`GitHub` HenryHe520/dsh-time-pin

**Pin the agent's "now" to a point in time and give the conversation a dated
evidence window around

it — a range before and after the pin, past, future, or
BC — instead of letting it answer from today

fore and after the pin, past, future, or
BC — instead of letting it answer from today's knowledge.**

Time Anchor adds a session-scoped time frame to every DSH conversation: an
**as-of** time point plus

a **retrieval range** split into a side before and a
side after it, together forming the evidence w

indow
`[as_of − before, as_of + after]`. In **restricted mode** the agent is told, once
per window c

hange, which window it may reason from and which evidence rules
apply; `web_search` results are filt

ered to *dated* sources inside that window,
and the first reply must echo the active window. A secon

d capability narrates
long-running silent **background** jobs with deterministic `[TIME FACT]` facts

(enabled by default and independent of the time window; turn it off in
Configure). In the default t

ime-window mode the plugin injects nothing and
filters nothing.

> **Honest disclaimer:** this is **evidence isolation, not model amnesia**. The
> model may still kn

ow about events after `as_of`; Time Anchor constrains what may
> be used as *evidence* and makes the

model state its window, but it cannot erase
> training knowledge and does not claim zero leakage. T

rust the cited sources,
> not the model's confidence.
## What it does
| Capability | What it gives you |
| **Pinned time window** | A chat-header control (and `/pin` command) that pins `as_of` and a retrie

val range on both sides, per conversation. Default, past, future, and BC years are all valid. |
| **
Evidence discipline** | In restricted mode the agent is told which window is authoritative, must cit
e dates, must treat undated and out-of-window material as unusable, and must say so when the window

has no usable evidence. |
| **Filtered web evidence** | `web_search` sources are dropped when they a
re undated or fall outside `[as_of − before, as_of + after]`; the model receives a note explaining w

hat was excluded. |
| **Anchor echo** | After entering or changing a restricted window, the model's
first reply must open with a one-line confirmation of the active window. A missing echo gets one nud

ge; anchoring never blocks the turn. |
| **Silent-job narration** | Background jobs that produce no
output for 90 seconds (then every 3 minutes) produce deterministic `[TIME FACT]` facts the model can
report — no guessing about "still running?". |
## Privacy and safety

- **Zero telemetry.** The plugin collects nothing, reports nothing, and phones
nothing home.
- **No

extra network access.** The only network use is the host's normal
`web_search`, which the plugin mer

ely filters.
- **No code evaluation.** No `eval`, no `new Function`, no dynamic code loading
beyond

the plugin's own modules.
- **No plugin-owned storage.** Window state lives in the session projectio

n
folded from the conversation's own log; injected text is attached with source
attribution (`time-p

in`), so it is visible in the transcript like any other
message. Settings edited on the Configure pa

ge are stored by the Harness
settings service in your profile, not in a plugin datastore. Removing t

he
plugin removes the behavior, not your data.
- **Human control.** The model cannot move the window

; `/pin` is human-only.
The plugin never blocks or rewrites model output — it shapes the evidence
fr
ame and reports facts.
## Compatibility

- DSH `0.2.1-rc.x` — built and verified on `0.2.1-rc.5`; peer ranges
`>=0.2.1-rc <2` for `@deepseek-

ai/dsh-*` packages, `@deepseek-ai/cordis`
`>=4.0.0-rc <5`, `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` `^3.18.0`, `zo

d` `^4`. The 0.1.0
build was also loaded live in a DSH desktop profile: the bundle row and its
confi

g schema, the chat-header chip, the Plugins **Configure** control
(`plugins.row.config` contributor

`dsh-time-pin#dsh-time-pin`) and the
`time_pin_status` tool registered and answered.
- Node.js `>= 2

0`.
- The chip/panel needs the Web/Desktop conversation UI
(`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-conversation

`, loaded together with the shipped
remote-command and locale modules). The Host half works in any i

nteractive
profile; `/pin` needs an interactive command surface (Web/Desktop chat or the
interactive

`dsh` CLI). Headless/ACP automation has no command surface, so the
window cannot be moved there.
-

No build step: the package is plain ESM and a hand-written lazy client bundle,
so a Git install work
s without compiling.
## How it works

- A **session projection** folds only standard session events
(`command/run`, `command/done`, `reque

st/header`, `assistant/message`,
`tool/result`, `turn/start`, `turn/end`) into the window state and

the
last-output/run-start timestamps. No custom event type is ever written, so
resume, replay, and f

ork restore the window by refolding the log.
[该节后续省略]
## Known limitations

- **Not amnesia.** The model may still know post-`as_of` events. Time Anchor
constrains evidence and

requires an explicit window statement; it cannot erase
training knowledge and does not promise zero

leakage.
- **`web_search` only.** Memory entries and workspace files are not filtered in
0.1.0 (def

erred) — prompt-pasted material has no machine date and must not be
used as window evidence by the m

odel.
- **Provider dates matter.** Search providers that return no dates make
restricted mode degrad

e to an honest "no dated evidence" answer; the parser
accepts several date formats but treats anythi

ng unrecognized as undated.
- **Background jobs only.** Model-facing silence narration covers backgr

ound
jobs. A foreground long-running tool call blocks the model's step, so the
model can only descri

be it after the tool returns.
- **Evidence notes are Chinese-only.** In 0.1.0 the one-line note appe

nded to a
filtered `web_search` result ("已排除 N 条无日期来源…") is fixed Chinese text
even when `promptLoca

le` is `en`; the window block and time facts are
localized.
- **Day granularity.** A window is a dat

e range, not a clock time; times of day
are not part of the frame.
- **Session-scoped.** The window

belongs to one conversation. It survives
resume, replay and fork (the fork inherits the parent's win

dow, then evolves
independently); it is not a global or profile-wide setting.
